{{Conjecture|legends}}
An '''individual''' was employed at the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Sector Command (Galactic Empire)/Legends|sector command]] on the celestial body [[Findris]]. They passed tactical information concerning the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Empire's military forces]] to [[Colonial News Nets]] assistant features editor [[Pertaal Shenvehr]], who in turn disseminated it to agents of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] in the form of coded messages embedded in the Colonial News Nets' advice column "[[Ask Argothil Anything]]."<ref name="CRO">''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]''</ref>
